title: Saturday Bouquet Order
briefing: You are the florist on a busy Saturday. Pull red roses and eucalyptus from the buckets, build a hand-tied bouquet in kraft paper, and get it to the customer.

lines.intro: Sam wants a hand-tied bouquet: red roses with eucalyptus. Flowers are in the buckets, the wrap is on the bench.
lines.done: Beautiful work. Sam will love it.

lines.intro: It's for my mum's birthday. Red roses are her favourite!

objectives.label: Pull the red roses from their bucket
Lay the roses on the workbench
Lay the eucalyptus on the workbench
Arrange the stems in the wrap and tie it with twine

say.text: Lovely spiral. Roses in the middle, greenery framing them.

objectives.label: Set the bouquet on the register counter

announce.text: The card reader just went down, and Sam has asked us to deliver it to his mum instead. He'll pay online. Put the bouquet in the delivery cart and send it with the driver.

replaceRemaining.label: Stand the bouquet in the delivery cart crate
Send it out with the driver

say.text: Mum's going to be so surprised. Thank you!

facts: Florists cut stems at an angle so they can take up more water.
A hand-tied bouquet is built in a spiral so the stems fan out and stand on their own.
Leaves below the water line are stripped to keep bacteria out of the vase.
Eucalyptus is a favourite filler because it lasts for weeks and smells fresh.
